predecessors.A1: L3 minimum bounded state-information candidate in the frozen common cohort; L4/L6 added no demonstrated future-response information there.
predecessors.A2: No tested simple storage-only closure had broad L3 support.
predecessors.A2B: Integrated-centroid and storage-constrained quasi-steady closures improved the severe S3 case but worsened all three S2 primary cases; decision A2B_NO_STORAGE_ONLY_CLOSURE_SUPPORTED.
predecessors.MECH1: Prior branch-local mechanism evidence attributes the dominant standard-LARE error to hydraulic-gradient reconstruction at a long-layer-to-local-layer interface.

scientific_question: Does one physically interpretable first vertical moment of water storage inside the L3 long layer supply the missing local profile information needed for a broadly supported long-to-local Darcy closure, and is that information more useful than spending the same fourth state on an explicit 130-140 cm storage layer?

L3_M1.M1_definition: M1_0_140 = (1/L) * integral_0^L [(z-L/2) * theta(z)] dz, L=140 cm, depth z positive downward
L3_M1.physical_interpretation: first centered vertical water-storage moment; equivalently the displacement of water storage toward the upper or lower part of the long layer

teacher_forced_state_source.reference: fine 16 x 10 cm B01 DYN0A fixed-flux Reference
teacher_forced_state_source.rule: All storage and moment coordinates are exact projections of the Reference state. No reduced-state propagation occurs in A3.

definition: Assume theta(z) is linear across 0-140 cm.
Mean theta is fixed by W_0_140 and slope is fixed analytically by M1_0_140.
Evaluate reconstructed theta and constitutive psi/K at z=135 cm, the center of the fine 130-140 cm cell adjacent to the 140 cm face.
Use the exact L3 140-150 cm layer mean as the lower 145 cm representative state.
Compute the 140 cm face flux with the same 10 cm center-to-center Darcy geometry and arithmetic interface conductivity as the fine Reference diagnostic.
Assume capillary head psi(z)=a+b*(z-70 cm) across 0-140 cm.
Solve a and b so the integrated mean theta and first centered theta moment exactly match W_0_140 and M1_0_140 under the frozen Mualem-Van Genuchten relation.
Evaluate psi/K at z=135 cm and combine with the exact 140-150 cm layer representative state using the same fine-face Darcy geometry.

controls.C_LARE_TAYLOR_L3: unchanged L3 storage-only long-interface baseline at 140 cm
controls.L4_LOCAL_140: same-dimension L4 140 cm local-local face identity control; expected to reproduce the fine face to numerical noise
controls.L4_LONG_130: same-dimension L4 actual long-to-local closure burden at 130 cm under standard LARE

response_vector: reconstructed capillary head at 135 cm error
140 cm interface maximum absolute flux error
140 cm interface mean signed flux error
same-dimension comparison with L4 long-interface 130 cm standard-LARE error

adjudication.moment_information_supported: At least one L3_M1 closure must be noninferior to L3 C_LARE_TAYLOR on every pooled primary flux component and reconstruction failure count, strictly improve at least one flux magnitude component, and not be worse than L3 C_LARE_TAYLOR on both RMS and maximum flux error in any primary case.
adjudication.same_dimension_value: Report L3_M1 against L4 as a vector. Do not collapse interface-local fidelity and representation simplicity to one score.
adjudication.propagation_gate: No A3 state may be propagated until the moment-information gate passes and a separate moment-evolution law is preregistered.
adjudication.failure_route: If neither first-moment closure passes, do not fit an empirical correction. Reconcile whether a second moment/front coordinate or explicit extra layer is scientifically preferable.

numerical_contract.quadrature: fixed 64-point Gauss-Legendre for M1 and nonlinear reconstruction, independently crosschecked at 128 points
numerical_contract.root_solve: deterministic least_squares for C_M1_LINEAR_PSI with fixed tolerances committed before execution
numerical_contract.physical_domain: theta_r < theta < theta_s and psi > 0.01 cm over the reconstructed long layer
identity_tests: uniform theta gives M1=0 and both moment closures reduce to the uniform constitutive state
synthetic linear-theta profile is exactly reconstructed by C_M1_LINEAR_THETA
synthetic linear-psi profile is recovered by C_M1_LINEAR_PSI
L4_LOCAL_140 reproduces the fine Reference 140 cm face operator to numerical precision

pre_execution_numerical_freeze.linear_psi_parameterization: psi_center = 0.01 + exp(x0); slope = [(psi_center-0.01)/(L/2)] * tanh(x1), guaranteeing psi>0.01 at both long-layer endpoints
pre_execution_numerical_freeze.failure_semantics: Any candidate reconstruction outside the frozen physical domain or beyond the residual/crosscheck gates is counted as a candidate failure; no fallback model or response-derived retuning is allowed.

pre_execution_operationalization.exact_reference_M1: For piecewise-constant 10 cm Reference cells, compute M1 exactly as sum(theta_i*dz_i*(z_i-70))/140 over z=0..140 cm.
pre_execution_operationalization.linear_theta_slope: b_theta = 12*M1/L^2; evaluate theta_135 = theta_bar + b_theta*(135-L/2). Reject if the reconstructed long-layer endpoint theta values leave (theta_r,theta_s).
linear_psi_initialization: Construct an affine-theta endpoint estimate from b_theta. If both endpoint theta values are physical, map them to psi and use their secant slope as the initial psi slope; otherwise initialize slope=0.

Map the initial slope into the frozen tanh parameterization and clip only the internal tanh argument to +/-0.95 to remain inside the preregistered positive-psi domain. This is numerical initialization, not a fitted coefficient.
Every observation is solved fresh from its own state-derived initial value; no response-based warm start or fallback closure is allowed.
pre_execution_operationalization.reference_face_formula: q_ref at 130/140 cm uses the adjacent fine-cell MvG conductivities with arithmetic mean and the 10 cm pressure-head gradient, matching the frozen DYN0A swkmean=1 diagnostic.
pre_execution_operationalization.comparison_semantics: L4_LOCAL_140 is an operator identity guard. L4_LONG_130 is the same-scalar-dimension localization control and is reported as a vector, not folded into the A3 support gate.
pre_execution_operationalization.scientific_effect: NONE; this freezes deterministic implementation details before any A3 moment result.

pre_execution_authority_reconciliation.scientific_effect: NONE. State coordinates, closures, cases, partitions, response vector and adjudication are unchanged.
